import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases

open Finset

theorem rmo_2000_3
  (x : ℕ → ℝ)
  (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < x n)
  (hmono : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1))
  (hsq : ∀ N, (Ico 1 (N + 1)).sum (fun i => x (i * i) / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 1) :
  ∀ k, (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
  intro k
  have h_main : (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 3 := by
    -- Use the square root of k to partition the sum into blocks
    let m := Nat.sqrt k
    have h_m_sq : m * m ≤ k := Nat.sqrt_le' k
    have h_k_lt : k < (m + 1) * (m + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt k
    
    -- Split the sum into blocks [j^2, (j+1)^2) for j = 1 to m-1, plus a final partial block
    have h_sum_split : 
      (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) = 
        (∑ j in Ico 1 m, ∑ i in Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), x i / (i : ℝ)) +
        (∑ i in Ico (m * m) (k + 1), x i / (i : ℝ)) := by
      have h₁ : (Ico 1 (k + 1)) = 
        (⋃ j ∈ Ico 1 m, Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))) ∪ Ico (m * m) (k + 1) := by
        ext i
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_Ico]
        constructor
        · intro h
          by_cases h₂ : i < m * m
          · -- i is in some earlier block
            have h₃ : 1 ≤ i := by linarith [h.1]
            have h₄ : i < m * m := h₂
            -- Find j such that j^2 ≤ i < (j+1)^2
            have h₅ : ∃ j, j ∈ Ico 1 m ∧ i ∈ Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) := by
              use Nat.sqrt i
              have h₆ : Nat.sqrt i < m := by
                apply Nat.sqrt_lt.mpr
                nlinarith
              have h₇ : 1 ≤ Nat.sqrt i := by
                apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
                exact Nat.pos_sqrt.mpr (by positivity)
              have h₈ : (Nat.sqrt i) * (Nat.sqrt i) ≤ i := Nat.sqrt_le' i
              have h₉ : i < (Nat.sqrt i + 1) * (Nat.sqrt i + 1) := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt i
              constructor
              · exact ⟨h₇, h₆⟩
              · constructor <;> norm_cast <;> nlinarith
            obtain ⟨j, hj, hij⟩ := h₅
            exact Or.inl ⟨j, hj, hij⟩
          · -- i is in the last block
            have h₃ : m * m ≤ i := by linarith
            have h₄ : i < k + 1 := by linarith [h.2]
            exact Or.inr ⟨h₃, h₄⟩
        · intro h
          cases h with
          | inl ⟨j, hj, hij⟩ =>
            simp_all [Finset.mem_Ico]
            <;> omega
          | inr ⟨hi1, hi2⟩ =>
            simp_all [Finset.mem_Ico]
            <;> omega
      rw [h₁]
      have h₂ : Disjoint (⋃ j ∈ Ico 1 m, Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))) (Ico (m * m) (k + 1)) := by
        intro z hz
        rcases hz with ⟨⟨j, hj, hjz⟩, _⟩ | ⟨_, _⟩
        · -- z is in both sets
          have h₃ : z < (j + 1) * (j + 1) := hjz.2
          have h₄ : (j + 1) * (j + 1) ≤ m * m := by
            have h₅ : j < m := hj.2
            have h₆ : j + 1 ≤ m := by omega
            nlinarith
          linarith
        · contradiction
      rw [Finset.sum_union h₂]
      rw [Finset.sum_Union]
      · congr
        ext j
        simp [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_iff]
        <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try {
          simp_all [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_iff]
          <;> omega
        })
      · intro j hj
        simp_all [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_iff]
        <;> omega
    
    rw [h_sum_split]
    
    -- Bound each block
    have h_block_bound : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j < m → 
      ∑ i in Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), x i / (i : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) := by
      intro j hj1 hjm
      have h_card : (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card = 2 * j + 1 := by
        simp [Finset.Ico.card, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul]
        ring_nf
        <;> omega
      have h_mono_block : ∀ i ∈ Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
        intro i hi

        have h₂ : i < (j + 1) * (j + 1) := hi.2
        have h₃ : ∀ n, x n ≥ x (n + 1) := hmono
        have h₄ : x i ≤ x (j * j) := by

            intro k hk1 hk2

          have h₇ : x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
            have h₈ : ∀ n, j * j ≤ n → n ≤ i → x n ≥ x (n + 1) := by
              intro n hn1 hn2
              exact hmono n
            -- Since sequence is nonincreasing and j^2 ≤ i, we have x_i ≤ x_{j^2}
            have h₉ : x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
              have h₁₀ : ∀ k, j * j ≤ k → k ≤ i → x k ≥ x i := by
                intro k hk1 hk2
                induction' hk2 - hk1 with l hl IH
                · simp
                · have h₁₁ : x (l + 1) ≤ x l := hmono l
                  linarith
              specialize h₁₀ (j * j) (by nlinarith) (by nlinarith)
              linarith
            exact h₉
          exact h₇
        exact h₄
      have h_inv_bound : ∀ i ∈ Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (j * j : ℝ) := by
        intro i hi
        have h₁ : (j * j : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by
          norm_cast
          exact hi.1
        have h₂ : 0 < (j * j : ℝ) := by
          have h₃ : 0 < j := by omega
          positivity
        have h₃ : 0 < (i : ℝ) := by
          have h₄ : 0 < j := by omega
          have h₅ : 0 < j * j := by positivity
          have h₆ : (j * j : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := h₁
          linarith
        have h₄ : (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (j * j : ℝ) := by
          apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
          · positivity
          · exact h₁
        exact h₄
      calc
        ∑ i in Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), x i / (i : ℝ)
          ≤ ∑ i in Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1)), x (j * j) / (j * j : ℝ) := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            have h₁ : x i ≤ x (j * j) := h_mono_block i hi
            have h₂ : (1 : ℝ) / (i : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (j * j : ℝ) := h_inv_bound i hi
            have h₃ : 0 < x (j * j) := hpos (j * j)
            have h₄ : 0 < (j * j : ℝ) := by
              have h₅ : 0 < j := by omega
              positivity
            have h₅ : 0 < (i : ℝ) := by
              have h₆ : 0 < j := by omega
              have h₇ : 0 < j * j := by positivity
              have h₈ : (j * j : ℝ) ≤ (i : ℝ) := by
                norm_cast
                exact hi.1
              linarith
            calc
              x i / (i : ℝ) = x i * (1 / (i : ℝ)) := by field_simp
              _ ≤ x (j * j) * (1 / (i : ℝ)) := by gcongr
              _ ≤ x (j * j) * (1 / (j * j : ℝ)) := by gcongr
              _ = x (j * j) / (j * j : ℝ) := by field_simp
          _ = (Ico (j * j) ((j + 1) * (j + 1))).card • (x (j * j) / (j * j : ℝ)) := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
            <;> field_simp
          _ = (2 * j + 1 : ℝ) * (x (j * j) / (j * j : ℝ)) := by
            rw [h_card]
            <;> norm_cast
            <;> field_simp
          _ ≤ 3 * (x (j * j) / (j : ℝ)) := by
            have h₁ : 0 < (j : ℝ) := by
              have h₂ : 0 < j := by omega
              exact_mod_cast h₂
            have h₂ : 0 < x (j * j) := hpos (j * j)
            have h₃ : (2 * j + 1 : ℝ) / (j * j : ℝ) ≤ 3 / (j : ℝ) := by
              have h₄ : 0 < (j : ℝ) := h₁
              have h₅ : 0 < (j * j : ℝ) := by positivity
